verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server (fivetran-mcp) that lets an agent ask read-only questions like sync status ('was my last postgres sync successful', 'are any of my connections broken') and, with write/delete scope enabled, trigger actions like re-syncing connections; the REST API also exposes sync status and trigger/re-sync endpoints. This covers status checks, diagnosis, and re-triggering via both API and MCP. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's re-trigger reliability, and no explicit end-to-end diagnostic workflow example (e.g., pulling error logs before retriggering) in the evidence.
